solver: exact subset dynamic programming; no random seed

objectives.N-opt: min N, then E, then cumulative T
objectives.E-opt: min E, then N, then cumulative T
objectives.T-opt: min cumulative T, then E, then N

scope: O01-service-O01; indivisible boxes; A/B/C per sortie; safe payload, volume and available energy enforced; fleet scheduling, shared batteries and deadlines excluded
